notes.title: THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD: Remake - now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Traverse the grotesque mansion once more and behold the Curien's masterpiece!

• Well known arcade classic with modern graphics and controls, including gyro aiming
• True to the original gameplay
• Local 2-player multiplayer
• Multiple endings
• Photomode
• Achievements
• Armory with unlockable weapons
• Hordes of the undead monstrosities in a new game mode
• Gallery with encountered enemies and bosses

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1694600/THE_HOUSE_OF_THE_DEAD_Remake/

notes.title: Drone Hunter VR v1.2 Patch
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27202173/fe054bac89f64a9d872e65c131d6db76ca227aaf.png

Hello again, 

We are back with the next game update! 
Lots of you were complaining about Drone Hunter's voice in the background, so we decided to fix it ASAP. 
Now you will only hear the main hero at strategic points of the game. We hope that it won't disturb your gameplay anymore! 
In the future patches, there will appear a permanent turn on/off mode for additional voice effects. 

> At this point, it's high time to explain some lore stuff. Why at all a robot has it's own voice? And why it may seem to be a little haunting during the gameplay...

Android DH125 is not only a war machine - there are still some remains of it's own eccentric cyber-personality. 

But hey, everyone would go nuts trapped all alone at the space station! 
Crazy ego of DH125 is trying to absorb anyone who tries to control him. The recruits' hidden task is to subjugate him, as the government still has some problems with it, but shh... top secret. <


We really do appreciate all your feedback (both shoulder patting and critic), so keep it up! 
Your suggestions are always welcome in "Feedback/Improvements" topic on our community thread. 
Below you'll find the newest patch release notes.


Drone Hunter VR v1.2 Patch 

Changes in the latest version: 

Voice reduction - random quotes has been turned off, now you will hear it only in critical points of the game
Improved graphics - shape and color of lasers / missiles has been enhanced 
Few minor bugs fixed

*Steam cards collection will soon been added!

notes.title: DRONE HUNTER VR 1.1 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27202173/f5d95cd68ceddb5782b2f3833d01d6e6d04653c8.jpg

Hi there, 

We wanted to share some information about the latest update. Thanks to your feedback we were able to make some improvements, which will hopefully make the gameplay even more pleasurable. If you have any other suggestions, please write a post in the "Feedback/Improvements" topic on our community forum. We want to constantly improve the game according to your suggestions. The newest patch release notes are available below. 


Drone Hunter VR v1.1 Patch

Changes in the latest version:
Improved graphics - new space station, new space background
Fixed leaderbords - some players were complaining about some problems with the leaderboards display. We have identified the issue and fixed it.
Improved aiming - when multifire is maxed out, the central missile is much bigger for easier aiming
Minor changes in shaders
Few minor bugs fixed
